Medium-specific page/view layouts must preserve the one common metric scale and document tile/order rules inside the shared master/export recipe. Physical printer compatibility is not established. Circles are diameter-comparison tokens, not realistic silhouettes or assertions that oblate giants are perfect spheres. Native1015 shows large Jupiter/Saturn-like circles, a Saturn ring and tiny bodies with unread names. Its complete membership, Pluto inclusion and numbers are not certified. Independent eight-planet membership and pinned equatorial values replace that uncertainty without exact-source coverage. Saturn ring span is not body diameter. Moon and Pluto columns in the NASA table are deliberately not among the eight selected planets; their separate corpus identities are not excluded. Teacher/audio key gives row order Mercury/Venus/Earth/Mars, then Jupiter/Saturn/Uranus/Neptune. One comparison relation, not eight extra body masters. Only within-chart diameters are metric; page separation and centre positions do not encode orbital distance or area/volume ratios. Metric reference centreline quantity differs from painted outer/inner diameter. No literalplanetshape/area/volume/uncertainty encoding.
